name: Snooze Screensaver
description: While an alarm rings, a black screen shows the time, the snooze count and a hint. A tap or a hardware key snoozes, a double tap or a second key press stops. Counts and limits snoozes and says a short text after each step. Works without Home Assistant; speech uses KS's alarm voice or, with its own volume, a Home Assistant action. Needs the Clock or Weather Mood screensaver with Let alarms take over: KS's own alarm screen covers plugin overlays.
author: d3rb3rt

settings.title: Snooze label
settings.description: The big text on the ringing screen. Empty: the built-in text in the chosen language.

settings.title: Show the time
settings.description: Shows the current time above the snooze label.

settings.title: Maximum snoozes
settings.description: 0 means unlimited. The last allowed snooze says so; after it a tap no longer snoozes and the alarm rings on until stopped. Also a number entity in Home Assistant.

settings.title: Double tap window
settings.description: A single tap runs after this wait, unless a second tap follows within it.

settings.title: Snooze keys
settings.description: Keys that snooze while the alarm rings (Android names without KEYCODE_, comma-separated). A key also listed under Stop keys stops on a quick second press. Empty: no key snoozes.

settings.title: Stop keys
settings.description: Keys that stop the alarm, also while it is snoozed. Empty: no key stops. Turn on KS's option to swallow the volume keys if they should not change the volume.

settings.title: Second key press window
settings.description: A second press of a snooze and stop key within this time stops the alarm. A snooze-only key ignores it.

settings.title: Hint text
settings.description: Shown below the snooze label while the alarm rings. Empty: the built-in text in the chosen language. A single - means no hint.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Language of the built-in texts. Auto follows the device (German or English, otherwise English). Texts you type are used as they are.

settings.title: Speech through
settings.description: KS alarm voice speaks at the alarm volume. Home Assistant uses the action below with its own volume per text, until KS offers a volume for alarm speech.

settings.title: Home Assistant speak action
settings.description: As domain.action, e.g. this kiosk's esphome.<name>_announce (Developer tools > Actions, type announce). Only with Speech through Home Assistant.

settings.title: Extra action data (JSON)
settings.description: More fields for the action; the text goes as "message". Empty fits a kiosk announce action.

settings.title: Text on tap
settings.description: Said after a snooze, in KS's alarm voice and volume (Settings > Alarms). Empty: built-in text. - : silence. Placeholders: {n} this snooze, {total} snooze minutes so far, {length} one snooze, {max} the limit.

settings.title: Volume of this text
settings.description: Only with Speech through Home Assistant and a kiosk announce action, sent as its volume. 0 sends none.

settings.title: Text on double tap
settings.description: Said after the plugin stops the alarm. Empty: built-in text. - : silence. Placeholders: {n} this snooze, {total} snooze minutes so far, {length} one snooze, {max} the limit.

settings.title: Volume of this text
settings.description: Only with Speech through Home Assistant and a kiosk announce action, sent as its volume. 0 sends none.

settings.title: Text on last snooze
settings.description: Said instead of the snooze text on the last allowed snooze. Empty: built-in text. - : silence. Placeholders: {n} this snooze, {total} snooze minutes so far, {length} one snooze, {max} the limit.

settings.title: Volume of this text
settings.description: Only with Speech through Home Assistant and a kiosk announce action, sent as its volume. 0 sends none.
